'''Anwar Ahmad Khan''' (born 1947), better known as '''Dr. A. A. Khan''', is an Indian physicist. He was the [[Vice Chancellor]] of [[Ranchi University]] from 2006 to 2011.

==Early life and education==
Khan was born in 1947 in [[Nauhatta, Dist- Saharsa]]. He earned an [[MSc]] from [[Patna University]] in 1968 and a [[PhD]] in electronics in 1977.<ref name=milligazette>{{cite web |url= http://www.milligazette.com/Archives/2004/01-15Aug04-Print-Edition/011508200441.htm |title=Newsmakers, The Milli Gazette, Vol.5 No.15, MG109 (1–15 Aug 04) |work=milligazette.com |accessdate=28 May 2012}}</ref>

==Academic career==
Khan started his academic career in 1969 as an electronics lecturer in [[Magadh University]]. In 1978 he joined [[Ranchi University]] where he spent most of his academic career, reaching the positions of Head of the Department of Physics, and then [[Pro Vice Chancellor]] in 2004,<ref name=milligazette/> and [[Vice Chancellor]] from 2006 to 2011.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20120509192717/http://ranchiuniversity.org.in/university/university-a/list-of-vice-chancellors.html List of former Vice Chancellors of Ranchi University]</ref> He also spent ten-year (from 1983 to 1988 and from 1990 to 1995) at the electrical engineering department at [[King Saud University]].<ref name=milligazette/>
